source: No other common foul had more than 53% of its calls in the first half.
why: The data file contains only defensive three seconds calls; it has no play-by-play records for other foul types, so the comparison with other common fouls cannot be computed.

source: Between 2015 and 2018, NBA officials reviewed over 1,400 games and identified 141 instances of defensive three seconds in the last 2 minutes of close games. It was called only once.
why: This finding comes from the NBA's Last Two Minute Report data, which is not included in three-seconds.csv; the file only covers called defensive three seconds fouls, not reviewed missed calls.

source: a close examination of the NBA's play-by-play data reveals that defensive three seconds is the NBA's least consistently called rule
why: Establishing that defensive three seconds is the least consistently called rule requires call records for all other rules to compare against; the data file contains only defensive three seconds calls.
